name: my-co-run
_doc: Pipeline: run_co.sh  —  two models (A and B) train collaboratively. Each step: both generate via separate vLLM servers, cross-score each other's completions, then each model trains on a selected subset of both models' responses.

models._model_a: Path to initial Model A checkpoint.
models._model_b: Path to initial Model B checkpoint.

dataset._key: Dataset identifier. Options: 'math_lighteval', 'gsm8k', etc. See utils/dataset.py.
dataset._max_samples: Cap on total problems loaded. null = use all.
dataset._system_prompt: System message prepended to every prompt (applied to both models with their respective chat templates).
dataset.system_prompt: You are a helpful AI Assistant, designed to provided well-reasoned and detailed responses. You FIRST think about the reasoning process step by step and then provide the user with the answer. Please enclose your final answer in the box: \boxed{Your Answer}. Please stop generation immediately after outputing the box.
dataset._prompt_mode: Predefined prompt preset: 'system' (system prompt, no suffix), 'suffix' (no system, instruction suffix), 'bare' (nothing, TTRL style). null = use individual fields.
dataset._instruction_suffix: Instruction suffix appended to user message. null = use per-dataset default. Empty string = no suffix.
dataset._enable_thinking: Control enable_thinking for chat template. 'false' (default), 'true', 'none' (don't pass — TTRL style).
dataset._problems_per_step: Problems sampled per step. Effective samples per model = problems_per_step × num_generations_per_model.

generation._num_generations_per_model: Completions generated per problem by EACH model. Total pool per prompt = 2 × num_generations_per_model, laid out as [A_0..A_{N-1}, B_0..B_{N-1}].
generation._max_completion_length: Max tokens per completion (vLLM and training cap).

scoring._scoring_batch_size: Prompts per scoring batch (in-process). Reduce if GPU OOM.
scoring._logps_batch_size: Prompts per logp computation batch. Reduce if GPU OOM.

reward._method:
Reward method for co-learning. Options:
  'sum_scores'  — continuous reward = weight_a×score_a + weight_b×score_b (intuitor-style).
  'self_scores' — each model's completions rewarded only by that model's own score (A→score_a, B→score_b).
  'truth'       — ground-truth 0/1 rewards from dataset answer_column (HACRL scorer).
  'co_wmv'      — Z-score normalize A/B scores, WMV pseudo-label → binary 0/1 rewards.
  'co_mv'       — unweighted majority vote → binary 0/1 rewards.
reward._scorer: HACRL scorer backend for method='truth'. Options: default | hacrl_math_dapo | hacrl_math_boxed | hacrl_prime_math | hacrl_gsm8k | hacrl_qa_em. Ignored when method != 'truth'.
reward._weight_a: Weight for model A's score when method=sum_scores. E.g. 1.0 = full A, 0 = ignore A.
reward._weight_b: Weight for model B's score when method=sum_scores. E.g. 1.0 = full B, 0 = ignore B. Use weight_a=1,weight_b=0 for A-only; weight_a=0.6,weight_b=0.4 for custom ratio.
reward._beta: KL penalty coefficient β. 0.0 = no KL penalty.

training._num_gpus: GPUs for training. Both A and B train sequentially on this many GPUs.
training._start_step: Step to resume from. 0 = start fresh.
training._warmup_ratio: Fraction of steps for linear LR warmup.
training._objective_mode: Policy objective. Use 'gspo' for sequence-level GSPO in co pipeline; 'grpo' keeps legacy behavior.
training._co_update_mode: Co update scheduling. 'two_phase' = self phase then peer phase per model per step; 'mixed' = legacy mixed batch.
training._is_length_norm: Length normalization for sequence-level IS in GSPO. Options: 'mean', 'sqrt_len', 'none'.
training._is_strict_old_for_peer: If true, peer phase requires cached old logps from peer model and errors if missing.
training._capability_weight_mode: Capability-ratio source for w(k,j). 'sc_ratio' for intuitor SC, 'reward_ratio' for mv/co_mv.
training._capability_ratio_smoothing: Smoothing for capability ratio mean reward. 'latest' = current step only (default). 'last_k' = sliding window average over last K steps.
training._capability_ratio_k: Window size K for 'last_k' smoothing. Default: 5.
training._capability_normalize_sce: When true, normalize raw SCE scores to [0,1] (z-score + sigmoid) before computing capability ratio w(k,j). Only affects SCE-based reward methods. Default: false.
training._strong_model_peer_penalty: When > 0, subtract this value from the weak model's capability weight w(peer->train) during the strong model's peer-loss scaling. 0.0 = disabled.
training._model_ids: Model identifiers. Current implementation is validated for two models, but interfaces are list-based for future extension.
training._accelerator_config: Shared accelerate config → recipes/accelerate_configs/<name>.yaml. Used as fallback when per-model configs are not set. Options: 'zero3', 'zero3_offload', 'zero3_2gpu', 'zero3_4gpu', 'zero3_offload_2gpu', 'zero3_offload_4gpu'.
training._accelerator_config_a: Accelerate config for Model A only. Overrides the shared accelerator_config. null = use shared value.
training._accelerator_config_b: Accelerate config for Model B only. Overrides the shared accelerator_config. null = use shared value.
training._gradient_accumulation_steps: Shared fallback for gradient_accumulation_steps_a/b if per-model values are not set.
training._per_device_batch_size: Shared fallback for per_device_batch_size_a/b if per-model values are not set.
training._gradient_accumulation_steps_a: Gradient accumulation steps for Model A. Overrides the shared value. Set so: num_gpus × per_device_batch_size_a × gradient_accumulation_steps_a = problems_per_step × learn_count_a.
training._gradient_accumulation_steps_b: Gradient accumulation steps for Model B (can differ from A for mixed-size models).
training._per_device_batch_size_a: Per-GPU micro-batch size for Model A training.
training._per_device_batch_size_b: Per-GPU micro-batch size for Model B training.
training._self_update_epsilon_low: Lower epsilon for self-update GSPO clipping. Overrides global epsilon for self-phase. null = use global epsilon.
training._self_update_epsilon_high: Upper epsilon for self-update GSPO clipping. Overrides global epsilon_high for self-phase. null = use global epsilon_high.
training._peer_special_clip_asymmetric_enabled: Asymmetric peer clipping: IS ratio can only downweight (ratio <= 1.0).
training._peer_special_clip_stepwise_enabled: Stepwise peer clipping: lower bound tightens with each optimizer step k. lower = 1 - delta + k * delta_step.
training._peer_special_clip_delta: Delta for stepwise peer clip. Default: 0.8.
training._peer_special_clip_delta_step: Delta-step for stepwise peer clip. Default: 0.4.
training._peer_is_reweight_enabled: Enable non-gradient exponential reweighting for peer IS ratios in J_hete. When enabled and IS ratio < 1.0: ratio_new = ratio * sg(ratio)^alpha.
training._peer_is_reweight_alpha: Alpha (α ≥ 0) for non-gradient exponential reweighting. Larger alpha suppresses low IS ratios more aggressively. Only used when peer_is_reweight_enabled is true. Default: 0.5.
training._learn_config:
JSON object controlling which responses each model trains on and how they are selected. null = use legacy static indices.
Format: {"a": {"own": N, "other": M}, "b": {"own": N, "other": M}, "selection": "<mode>"}
  own    = how many of the model's own completions to include (-1 = all).
  other  = how many of the other model's completions to include (-1 = all, 0 = self-learning).
  selection = 'first'     — take the first N in generation order (DEFAULT, static, deterministic).
              'top_score' — rank by score_a + score_b per prompt, pick the highest-scored N.
              'random'    — random subset (seeded by step + prompt index).
Example (4 gen/model, A learns own 4 + top 3 of B): {"a":{"own":4,"other":3},"b":{"own":4,"other":3},"selection":"top_score"}

vllm._port_a: vLLM server port for Model A.
vllm._port_b: vLLM server port for Model B. Must differ from port_a.
vllm._gpu_a: CUDA device index for Model A's vLLM server.
vllm._gpu_b: CUDA device index for Model B's vLLM server. Must differ from gpu_a.
vllm._gpu_memory_utilization: vLLM KV-cache memory fraction for both servers.
vllm._max_model_len: Max sequence length for vLLM. Must be ≤ both models' max_position_embeddings.
vllm._max_num_seqs: Max concurrent sequences per vLLM server.
vllm._max_num_batched_tokens: Max total tokens per vLLM batch.
vllm._start_timeout: Seconds to wait for vLLM health check.
vllm._auto_start: If true, start vLLM servers automatically at the beginning of each step. If false, servers must already be running (useful for pre-warmed setups).
vllm._auto_stop: If true, stop vLLM servers after generation is complete each step to free GPU memory for training.

output._checkpoint_dir: Root directory for checkpoints. Subdirectories model_a/ and model_b/ are created automatically.
output._lighteval_prefix: Output prefix for LightEval results (step number and model tag are appended).
output._ttrl_dir: Root directory for TTRL evaluation results.

eval._doc: Each evaluation backend is independently toggleable. Set 'enabled' to true and fill in 'tasks' to activate.
eval._max_new_tokens: Max tokens generated during evaluation (shared across backends).
eval._local_datasets_root: Local HuggingFace dataset cache directory (shared across backends).

lighteval._doc: LightEval backend (vLLM). Set enabled=true and list tasks to activate.
lighteval._prompt_mode: Prompt preset for lighteval wrapper: 'system' (use system_prompt) | 'bare' (no system).
lighteval._system_prompt: Optional lighteval-only system prompt. null = fall back to dataset.system_prompt.

zeroeval._doc: ZeroEval backend (CRUXEval etc.). Set enabled=true and list tasks to activate.

hacrl._doc: HACRL scorer backend (sympy / Minerva / boxed / QA). Set enabled=true, pick a scorer, and list tasks.
hacrl._scorers: default | hacrl_math_dapo | hacrl_math_boxed | hacrl_prime_math | hacrl_gsm8k | hacrl_qa_em

ttrl._doc: TTRL evaluation backend (TTRL-style scoring on TTT datasets). Set enabled=true and list tasks to activate.
